title: claim_ring
description: The target player claims a ring that nobody has claimed, unclaimed or contested, e.g. to resolve an effect (Display of Power): it goes to their claimed ring pool, with the fate on it. The ring is claimed in `conflict_type`, by default the type of the conflict being resolved; outside of a conflict, `conflict_type` is required. A contested ring claimed this way is not claimed again by the winner of the conflict.

ring.description: Ring to claim, unclaimed or contested.

conflict_type.description: Type of the conflict the ring is claimed in; by default, the type of the conflict being resolved.
